answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using free-space optical ranging. Nodes authenticate by steering narrow laser pulses between fixed landmarks, such as an alpine summit and a river bridge. An attacker must deploy discrete optical gimbals and secure clear sightlines per identity instead of multiplying software clones. However, atmospheric scintillation and beam occlusions from airborne debris, like a drifting quill, can cause false rejections.
